Independent algebraic off-diagonal sign check via f′ and rational substitution at the partwise witness
correctness.rationale: The endpoint scalar filter has no poles for nonnegative arguments. The Laplacian acts by 0 on the constants, by q=N−p on mean-zero vectors supported in a part of size p, and by N on the part-constant centered space. The projectors give diagonals 1/N+(1−1/p)R(qh)+(1/p−1/N)R(Nh). Writing f(z)=(1−R(z))/z=(z+6)/(z²+4z+6), the between-part off-diagonal equals h f(Nh)>0 and the within-part off-diagonal equals (qh/p)[f(qh)−f(Nh)]>0 for h>0, since f′ is strictly negative on nonnegative arguments. The global scalar minimum is (5−3√3)/2 at z=3+3√3. The resulting lower bound on a diagonal has numerator at least 26−15√3>0 through order 11. For h=8/q and t=p/N, direct substitution uses R(8)=−5/51 and R(8/(1−t))=−(1−t)(5+3t)/(51−22t+3t²). The negative of the resulting diagonal has positive denominator and numerator N(255−110t+15t²)−2848+1056t. For N≥12 this numerator is bounded below by 4(45t²−66t+53)>0, since the quadratic has negative discriminant. The bound holds for every part, with no inference of a common negative timestep. At zero the endpoint is the identity, so the diagonals stay positive for small positive steps; at large steps the endpoint tends to J/N, so strict positivity returns. The uniform algebra rather than the supplied finite tests establishes the theorem.
residual_risks: The theorem pertains to endpoint matrices only, with unit edge weights and complete multipartite structure. It does not classify all reentry windows or internal stages.

evidence: Horváth–Song–Terlaky give a sufficient invariant-polyhedron step bound τ=γρ. Lóczi–Ketcheson study scalar absolute-monotonicity radii and their general positivity implications. The two earlier Horváth articles were not available in full to this review.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General sufficient conditions and scalar method radii do not give a sharp universal order cutoff on this graph family or a negative diagonal at an explicit step for all parts. The inaccessible titles leave a remaining literature risk rather than evidence of coverage or noncoverage.

This is substantial prior coverage, alongside overlapping star and K₂,q statements. The supported distinct contribution is the sharp result for arbitrary part profiles and a uniform explicit witness for each individual part at all orders N≥12. The inspected general time-discretization criteria do not imply that extension.

value.rationale: An all-step positivity bound for this endpoint update controls whether nonnegative data can acquire negative entries. The exact graph-order barrier for every part profile is stronger than a positive range from an unrestricted method criterion or isolated balanced examples. The simple explicit witness and all-time off-diagonal sign give usable information even though graph-specific positivity windows are not all classified.
residual_risks: No implication is asserted for arbitrary network topologies or arbitrary weighted profiles.
